# Everyone Film Editorial 1.4.0 — composition rules

Template `everyone-casting` 1.4.0 reproduces the supplied Floward cast shortlist (35 pages, 1920×1080).
The composer is `packages/templates/versions/1.4.0/compose-casting.ts`; the SQL mirror
`eps.editorial_deck_counts_1_4` (migration m19) re-derives every proof count from the frozen snapshot and is
checked against the composer on 301 synthetic snapshots (`tests/worker/editorial-1-4-sql-mirror.test.ts`).
The matrix below is enforced by `tests/domain/template-1-4-reference.test.ts`.

## What a page shows

Slides carry portraits only. Facts (age, city, measurements …) stay in the app and the Review panel. 1.4.0
replaces the "all ten fields" / "all provided facts on slides" rule **for new 1.4.0 series only**; 1.0–1.3
series and saved versions keep their own rules.

| Page | Content |
| --- | --- |
| Cover | `{Project} \| Cast Shortlist - V{n}.` (or `Cast Selection`), date line, optional highlighted `Note:` (series cover note), Everyone wordmark top right, client logo bottom right. Draft preview: no `- V{n}`, date line "Draft preview". |
| Scene divider | `Heading.` or `Heading \| Place.` (see scenes) |
| Cast page | `Cast Shortlist.` / `Cast Selection.`, subtitle `Heading \| Place \| Role.`, one to three portraits, labels only on Main/Backup pages, optional highlighted note bottom left, page number |
| Closing | `THANK YOU!` |

## Composition matrix (one role)

Order is the captured assignment order. Every candidate the output includes (Selection: every active
assignment; Shortlist: the shortlisted ones — decided by the server before composition) appears exactly once
per printed occurrence; nobody is invented, dropped or duplicated for pagination. Headcount, option count and
pictures per page are independent.

| Case | Pages (layout: sources, labels) |
| --- | --- |
| One intended portrait | `cast_single`: [1] |
| Main + Backup | `cast_main_backup`: [1, 2] Main, Backup |
| Main, no Backup | `cast_main_backup`: [1] Main + Backup silhouette (open Backup position, as reference p3/p5/p6) |
| Backup with a deliberately empty picture | `cast_main_backup`: [1, 2], Backup drawn as the silhouette (owner 2) |
| Backup without a Main | `cast_main_backup`: Main silhouette + [1] Backup |
| Options without a Main | unlabelled `cast_group_strip` / `cast_single` chunks |
| Main plus shortlisted Options | Main\|Backup page, then the Options unlabelled — Options are never dropped because a Main exists |
| Main + several Backups | Main\|Backup1, then labelled Backup pages of two (Backup\|Backup, or one Backup) — the Main is not repeated |
| 4 / 5 / 6 / 7 / 8 / 9 options | 2+2 / 3+2 / 3+3 / 3+2+2 / 3+3+2 / 3+3+3 (threes, ending with a pair or a three; a lone page only when there is one person) |
| Options across slots of one role | pooled in slot order, then chunked |
| Unfilled role (no one cast in any slot) | one `cast_pending` silhouette page with its slot/role/scene note, else "Note: Pending." |
| Filled role, person without media | the person's silhouette (owner set) plus a non-blocking review warning |

Notes: a slot note goes on the page that shows that slot's last person; the role note (or the scene
occurrence note, which takes precedence) goes on the role's last page; several notes on one page are joined.

Attribution: every portrait or person silhouette carries `data-fit-source=<captured slide>`; the page carries
`data-sources`. Open positions carry none. Subtitle, note and cover note are measured fit regions
(`presentation.subtitle`, `presentation.note`, `cover_note`, `scene_title`); type never shrinks — an overflow
is a blocking `LAYOUT_OVERFLOW` issue with a field-specific message.

### Known gap

The data model has no flag for "this Main deliberately has no Backup". A Main without a Backup therefore always
shows the Backup silhouette (what the reference does). A slot-level flag would be needed to print the Main alone.

## Pictures (one per person)

1. The workspace pin (`workspace_candidates.portrait_asset_id`, frame or archive photo) with its crop focus
   (`portrait_crop.focal_x/focal_y`, captured in thousandths; default 0.5/0.4), `object-fit: cover`, never stretched.
2. Else the first selected frame.
3. `intentionally_empty` → the reference silhouette, no issue.

Distinct missing states:

| State | Slide | Review |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Unfilled role | silhouette page, Pending/role note | `OPEN_SLOT` warning (existing) |
| Assigned, nothing pinned, no frame (`unset`) | silhouette | `NO_PRESENTATION_PICTURE` warning |
| Deliberately empty | silhouette | none |
| Pinned picture still processing | — | `PORTRAIT_PROCESSING` blocking |
| Pinned picture unavailable / not this person's | — | `PORTRAIT_UNAVAILABLE` blocking |
| Bytes missing or undecodable at render | — | the worker fails (`PDF_ASSET_INVALID`); never the silhouette |

1.3.0 (and earlier) series cannot draw archive photos: a person whose pin is a photo gets
`TEMPLATE_PORTRAIT_UNSUPPORTED` (blocking, when no frame exists; repair: create a 1.4.0 series) or
`TEMPLATE_PORTRAIT_SUBSTITUTED` (warning, the frame is shown). Frame-based 1.3.0 series are unaffected.

## Scenes

Only confirmed, non-archived scenes and occurrences are captured (scene order, then occurrence order).

- heading = sequence label, else scene title; place = occurrence `setting_override`, else scene setting, else
  (inside a sequence) the scene title.
- Consecutive scenes with the same sequence share one divider: `Heading.`; a lone scene with a place:
  `Heading | Place.`.
- `auto`: a role prints once, at its first `auto` occurrence, captioned with every `auto` place of that role
  in the same divider group (`Mother’s Birthday | Front Door & Home Gathering | Saudi Daughter.`).
- `repeat`: printed again at this occurrence (presentation repetition; casting records are shared).
- `hidden`: not printed here. A role printed by no scene, or with only hidden occurrences, is printed first,
  without a divider, so casting is never silently dropped.
- `display_title` replaces the role name in the subtitle.
- No scenes: roles in role order, no dividers (no category dividers).
- `slot_ids` on an occurrence is not used by 1.4.0 (the whole role prints) — documented limitation.

The Standard/Scene view in the app never changes the composition; the snapshot carries the scene context.
